proof_boundary: This proves the exact finite collar/far split, internal and outer rail transport, local diagonal and adjacent-corner phases, rail-compressed integration by parts, finite Gaussian moment boundary identities, and ideal-cubic source identities. It proves no signed tie-complete collar, far aggregate, finite first-correction remainder, completed current, Phi_B theorem, contact exclusion, retained aggregate or Xi theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.certificate: For r in C_p define I_(q,r)[P]=integral_(J_q)f_P(u)e(-ru)du and mathcal B_(q,p)[P]=sum_(r in C_p)I_(q,r)[P].
rows.claim: Every reciprocal block is a finite sum of physical-cell mode atoms.
rows.proof_boundary: No atom is estimated separately.

rows.certificate: For 0<=L<=N-1 define mathcal C_(N,L)[P]=sum_(|p-q|<=L)mathcal B_(q,p)[P] and mathcal E_(N,L)[P]=sum_(|p-q|>=L+1)mathcal B_(q,p)[P]. Then mathscr F_N[P]=mathcal C_(N,L)[P]+mathcal E_(N,L)[P].
rows.claim: Every finite radius gives an exact near/far partition.
rows.proof_boundary: The partition is algebraic.

rows.certificate: The bookmarked diagonal-plus-adjacent object is mathcal C_(N,1)=sum_q mathcal B_(q,q)+sum_(q<N)mathcal B_(q,q+1)+sum_(q>1)mathcal B_(q,q-1).
rows.claim: The diagonal-plus-adjacent object is exactly the radius-one collar.
rows.proof_boundary: It is not yet tie completed.

rows.certificate: For fixed p, the far physical cells are two contiguous rails: [1,p-L-1/2] when p>=L+2 and [p+L+1/2,N] when p<=N-L-1. Hence mathcal E_(N,L) is a sum of at most two oriented integrals per frequency cell, not a collection of independently bounded unit cells.
rows.claim: All far physical cells compress to two oriented intervals per frequency cell.
rows.proof_boundary: No modulus is taken.

rows.certificate: When alpha_P/r crosses p+1/2 upward, the mode r moves from C_p to C_(p+1). Its collar jump is 1_(p+L+1<=N)I_(p+L+1,r)-1_(p-L>=1)I_(p-L,r).
rows.claim: A reciprocal reassignment moves two collar rails.
rows.proof_boundary: The source is evaluated at the crossing.

rows.certificate: For L=1 the exact jump is 1_(p+2<=N)I_(p+2,r)-1_(p-1>=1)I_(p-1,r). The diagonal and two adjacent blocks therefore do not form an internal-tie-invariant object.
rows.claim: The diagonal-plus-adjacent collar has an explicit two-rail jump.
rows.proof_boundary: It is not globally invariant alone.

rows.certificate: The far complement has the opposite rail jump, so mathcal C_(N,L)+mathcal E_(N,L)=mathscr F_N remains invariant under every internal reassignment.
rows.claim: The far complement cancels the collar rail jump exactly.
rows.proof_boundary: The full band sum remains invariant.

rows.certificate: For the exact test source f(u)=u e(ru), every full-cell atom I_(q,r) equals q. At an interior tie the collar jump is 2L+1, proving that no proper fixed-width collar is coefficientwise tie invariant.
rows.claim: No proper fixed-width collar is coefficientwise tie invariant.
rows.proof_boundary: The witness is nonphysical and proves only structural nonclosure.

rows.certificate: At the two outer reciprocal-band crossings the complete mode, not only its near collar, is transferred to or from the outer remainder. The collar and both far rails must travel together.
rows.claim: Outer roster crossings transfer a complete mode.
rows.proof_boundary: Near and far pieces cannot be transferred separately.

rows.certificate: On a fixed roster-and-cell chart, mathcal C_(N,L)[i(lambda-c)P]=(partial_xi-ic)mathcal C_(N,L)[P] and likewise for mathcal E_(N,L). At a tie the two rail atoms and their relative lifts are transferred explicitly.
rows.claim: Fixed-cell relative lifting preserves the collar and far split.
rows.proof_boundary: Rail lifts are explicit at ties.

rows.certificate: For r in C_q put v=alpha_P/r and u=v(1+y). Then phi_r(u)=alpha_P(log v-1)+alpha_P{log(1+y)-y}. This is the exact negative Morse chart; no quadratic truncation is made.
rows.claim: The diagonal has an exact negative Morse chart.
rows.proof_boundary: No full-line replacement is made.

rows.certificate: For p=q+1 let c=q+1/2, u=c-a, v=c+b, and d=(a+b)/(c+b). Then phi_r(u)=alpha_P(log v-1)+alpha_P{log(1-d)+d}, with phi_r'(u)>=0 and equality only at the shared corner a=b=0.
rows.claim: The right adjacent block is an oriented stationary boundary corner.
rows.proof_boundary: Its endpoint is retained.

rows.certificate: For p=q-1 let c=q-1/2, u=c+a, v=c-b, and d=(a+b)/(c-b). Then phi_r(u)=alpha_P(log v-1)+alpha_P{log(1+d)-d}, with phi_r'(u)<=0 and equality only at the shared corner.
rows.claim: The left adjacent block has the opposite orientation.
rows.proof_boundary: Its endpoint is retained.

rows.certificate: Both corner corrections are strictly negative away from the shared boundary: d/d d[log(1-d)+d]=-d/(1-d) and d/d d[log(1+d)-d]=-d/(1+d). Their cubic terms have opposite orientations and cannot be replaced by one unsigned half-Gaussian.
rows.claim: Both exact corner phase corrections are negative away from contact.
rows.proof_boundary: This does not sign the complex amplitude integral.

rows.certificate: On either far rail, v=alpha_P/r lies in the p-cell and the physical variable lies outside [p-L-1/2,p+L+1/2]. Hence |v-u|>=L and q_r(u)=alpha_P/u-r has no zero for every L>=1.
rows.claim: The compressed far rails have no stationary point.
rows.proof_boundary: The bound is not yet aggregated.

rows.certificate: For q_r=alpha_P/u-r, integral_a^b A e(phi_r)du=kappa[Ae(phi_r)/q_r]_a^b-kappa integral_a^b e(phi_r){A'/q_r-Aq_r'/q_r^2}du on each oriented far interval.
rows.claim: One exact integration by parts applies to each far rail.
rows.proof_boundary: Endpoint orientation is preserved.

rows.certificate: The unit-cell boundary terms telescope before estimation because each far side is one contiguous interval. Only u=1, u=N, and the two collar rails p-L-1/2 and p+L+1/2 remain for each frequency cell.
rows.claim: Unit-cell integration-by-parts boundaries cancel before estimation.
rows.proof_boundary: Only physical and collar rails remain.

rows.certificate: The rail-compressed identity prevents an artificial O(N^2) boundary budget, but no signed or absolute aggregate bound for the remaining p,r sum is proved here.
rows.claim: Control the p,r aggregate after rail compression.
rows.proof_boundary: No far aggregate bound is claimed.

rows.certificate: The inherited full-line sequential coefficient remains -kappa mathcal D_qA/(2alpha_P)+kappa mathcal D_qA/(2alpha_P)=0 for arbitrary twice-differentiable A.
rows.claim: The inherited first sequential coefficient still cancels on the full line.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not a finite-cell theorem.

rows.certificate: On a finite negative chart, integral_a^b y^2e(-y^2/2)dy=kappa integral_a^b e(-y^2/2)dy-kappa[y e(-y^2/2)]_a^b.
rows.claim: Finite negative-chart second moments have an explicit boundary defect.
rows.proof_boundary: The endpoints are not discarded.

rows.certificate: On a finite positive chart, integral_c^d eta^2e(+eta^2/2)deta=-kappa integral_c^d e(+eta^2/2)deta+kappa[eta e(+eta^2/2)]_c^d.
rows.claim: Finite positive-chart second moments have the opposite boundary formula.
rows.proof_boundary: The endpoints are not discarded.

rows.certificate: The full-line cancellation uses vanishing regularized boundary terms. Finite diagonal and corner charts retain the four displayed endpoint terms; they may cancel only after the oriented collar rails, outer endpoints, and terminal recurrence are composed.
rows.claim: Full-line cancellation cannot be copied into a finite collar without boundary composition.
rows.proof_boundary: A complete endpoint cancellation remains open.

rows.certificate: The full-line cancellation uses vanishing regularized boundary terms. Finite diagonal and corner charts retain the four displayed endpoint terms; they may cancel only after the oriented collar rails, outer endpoints, and terminal recurrence are composed.
rows.claim: Compose and bound the finite moment boundary terms.
rows.proof_boundary: No finite correction remainder is proved.

rows.certificate: Retain P_H^0=-i(x+u_N)(x-u_N)^2/4 and P_T^0=-i(x-u_N)(x+u_N)^2/4+u_(N,x)(x-u_N) inside every block before a modulus is taken.
rows.claim: The two ideal cubics remain exact block amplitudes.
rows.proof_boundary: Corrections remain detached.

rows.certificate: At x=-u_q, P_H^0=i(u_q-u_N)(u_q+u_N)^2/4 and P_T^0=i(u_q+u_N)(u_q-u_N)^2/4-u_(N,x)(u_q+u_N).
rows.claim: The physical ideal atom values retain their phase-difference and phase-sum factors.
rows.proof_boundary: No atomwise sign is inferred.

rows.certificate: The exact polynomial relation is P_T^0(x)=-P_H^0(-x)+u_(N,x)(x-u_N). The physical interval is not reflection-symmetric, so this identity alone gives no cancellation or sign.
rows.claim: The Hermitian/transpose reflection has an explicit shear defect.
rows.proof_boundary: The physical domain is not reflection symmetric.

rows.certificate: At q=N, P_H^0(log N)=0 and P_T^0(log N)=-2u_Nu_(N,x). The transpose endpoint must remain joined to +2iu_N mathcal T_N[B_(T,N)^0] and the complex terminal recurrence.
rows.claim: The Hermitian endpoint vanishes and the transpose endpoint survives at shear scale.
rows.proof_boundary: The complex terminal quadrature remains compulsory.

rows.certificate: Since mathscr F_N=mathcal C_(N,1)+mathcal E_(N,1), the ideal carrier-only joins are mathcal J_H^0=2mathscr M_N[P_H^0]-mathcal C_(N,1)[P_H^0]-mathcal E_(N,1)[P_H^0] and mathcal J_T^0=2mathscr M_N[P_T^0]-mathcal C_(N,1)[P_T^0]-mathcal E_(N,1)[P_T^0]+2iu_Nmathcal T_N[B_(T,N)^0]. The collar rail jump cancels only against the far rail jump inside these complete joins.
rows.claim: The live Hermitian and transpose joins contain both the collar and far rails.
rows.proof_boundary: No component is signed separately.

rows.certificate: The diagonal-plus-adjacent collar is useful only on a fixed cell chart; it is not a globally closed observation. Preserve its two rail transfers and compose the rail-compressed far functional before seeking a uniform sign.
rows.claim: Replace the isolated three-strip target by a tie-complete collar-plus-far composition.
rows.proof_boundary: No valid cancellation route is discarded beyond the isolated collar.

rows.certificate: Insert P_H^0 and P_T^0 into the exact diagonal and corner charts, carry the four finite-moment boundary terms into the two rail interfaces, join 2mathscr M_N and the transpose terminal survivor, and then prove or falsify a signed aggregate for the resulting tie-complete collar-plus-far functional.
rows.claim: Derive the signed tie-complete ideal composition.
rows.proof_boundary: No signed ideal-cubic collar, far aggregate, finite first-correction remainder, h^2 reserve, completed current, or RH-level theorem is proved.

rows.certificate: No signed ideal-cubic collar, far aggregate, finite first-correction remainder, h^2 reserve, completed current, or RH-level theorem is proved.
rows.claim: This gate is not a proof of RH.
rows.proof_boundary: No prize-level conclusion is claimed.
